Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：古代的时候，The time phrase requires the structural particle 的 before 时候; the exception applies only to fixed monosyllabic forms such as 古时候.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物是安全的，什么植物是危险的，Two parallel embedded questions need complete predicate phrases, including 的 after each descriptive adjective.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 人不知道他们能吃什么植物：人们不知道什么植物能吃，Use 人们 for a concrete group of people; after the group has been named, the close repeated pronoun 他们 is unnecessary in this embedded question.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is a first mention, so introduce the character with a full noun phrase rather than using the name alone.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 告诉人：告诉人们，Use 人们, not generic 人, when referring to the particular people whom he informs.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，The telling is the final completed action in this past narrative sequence, so it needs 了.

items.reason: 古代 is not monosyllabic, so 古代的时候 requires 的.
The parallel predicates need 的 after 安全 and 危险.
人 refers to the concrete group in the story and should be 人们; the repeated 他们 is unnecessary here.
On first mention, the character should be introduced with a fuller noun phrase.
The people being informed are a concrete group, so 人们 is required rather than generic 人.
告诉 is the final action in the sequence and needs 了 under the teacher's series-of-actions rule.
